questions.question: What's the actual impact of fees and slippage on retail-size paper-traded crypto strategies?
questions.summary: ~$1/round-trip on $200 positions (0.25% taker both legs). Gross +$1,085 became net -$782 on the 3-month backtest — the delta is the answer. Fees erase thin edges.

questions.question: Which parameter ranges of Bollinger and MA-crossover are robust to regime shifts, and which are overfit?
questions.summary: None are robust: all 12 variants with n>100 negative over 6 months net of costs. Per-regime conditioning untested (rung 3).

questions.question: (Emergent) Do constraints or strategies determine outcomes at this scale?
questions.summary: Constraints dominate: 99.6% of candidate signals died on cooldown/exposure/concurrency. Candidate fitness = edge per constraint slot, not signal frequency.

questions.question: Does sentiment data (Fear & Greed) improve technical strategies, or is it noise?
questions.summary: Layer 2 (context) never went live; deferred past Phase 1b per one-factor-at-a-time.

questions.question: Does the walk-forward tuner produce variants that hold up out-of-sample?
questions.summary: tune.py never built; compare.py (the scoring instrument) now exists. Blocked on the candidate roster accumulating live trades.

learnings.claim: Short-horizon crypto continuation (≤24h, taker) has gross edge below the cost floor at every horizon ≤12h.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 K1 adjudication (ceiling-study evidence); 2026-07-18 extraction-engineering entry (ceiling measured at ~cost floor)

learnings.claim: Crypto momentum in 2024–26 is negative/reverting (0/9 cells, −12.4% directional).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 equity sky check sober reading (E1 result)

learnings.claim: Equity time-series momentum also lost to drift in-window (0/9 long-or-flat vs-drift cells in 2024–26); it is not alive in the time-series sense.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 equity sky check sober reading

learnings.claim: The survivorship-corrected cross-sectional 6-1 equity spread weakens toward zero (pooled +1.25%±1.23/mo, t=+1.02, n=43) with a window sign-flip, so no live cross-sectional edge is claimed.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 corrected equity re-score (report equity-sky-pit-2026-07-20.json)

learnings.claim: Survivorship bias in the equity archive is fixable at zero data cost because Alpaca serves full daily bars for delisted names (SIVB, FRC, SBNY, BBBYQ, MULN recovered).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 B2 corrected-archive registration; confirmed by 2026-07-20 corrected re-score recovering delisted names (978→2,494 usable symbols)

learnings.claim: The E2 equity program's real justification is breadth and falsification-throughput (thousands of names, ~0.05% costs, decades of regimes), not the sky-check magnitude.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 equity sky check sober reading; 2026-07-20 E2 OPENED entry (operator GO on breadth+throughput+cost basis)

learnings.claim: The equity pipeline is validated: 12-1 momentum was detected on the corrected archive with correct sign and the textbook momentum-crash signature (Daniel-Moskowitz).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 E2 round zero (report equity registry founding lesson); confirmed by 2026-07-20 UMD cross-check and identity-test entries

learnings.claim: The +14.9%/yr round-zero magnitude is not a deployable edge — far above the pre-registered 2–4%/yr band, only marginally significant (t=1.57, n=59), inflated by 2024-26 concentration.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 E2 round zero; construction confirmed by code inspection (long-only tilt, not 6-1 spread)

learnings.claim: The 2021-26 equity test window is typical, not an outlier regime: French UMD 2021-26 +0.47%/mo vs 1927-present +0.62%/mo, z=−0.26.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 UMD cross-check result (report umd-crosscheck-2026-07-20.json)

learnings.claim: The measured equity object's identity is momentum, supported chiefly by storm-conditional co-movement with UMD (+0.49 in high-|UMD| storm months vs +0.09 calm).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 identity test result (report umd-identity-2026-07-20.json)

learnings.claim: No equity price-factor candidate clears the best-of-4 hurdle (~1.7t); momentum is the only positive factor at +1.24%/mo t=1.57, sub-threshold.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 E2 round one (reports/equity-gauntlet-2026-07-23.json)

learnings.claim: The equity price-factor structure — single and combined, across weekly/monthly/quarterly on liquid large-caps — is null: efficient after costs; multi-factor composites reduce excess and IR vs momentum alone.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 E2 equity price-factor structure declared NULL (combination stage + round one + round 1b)

learnings.claim: Crypto shock-fade is a genuine lead: at a 72h pure hold, shock-fade n=18 nets +3.68%/tr (t=2.34, win 67%), positive in all three sub-regimes and beating placebo by +2.4%/tr.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 D1 shock-fade entry; horizon-unstable (120h dead) and n<30 quarantine, registered as shadow arm for forward out-of-sample accumulation

learnings.claim: The +0.3% kill bar at n=7 has a 21% false-positive rate, quantitatively vindicating the n<30 quarantine rule.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 power calibration (reports/power-calibration-2026-07-18.json)

learnings.claim: Reliable detection by this gauntlet starts ~+0.6% net edge; sub-bar real edges are unrecoverable one-at-a-time, so the meta-conclusion is downgraded to 'no edge ≥ ~0.6% net detectable by this instrument.'
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 power calibration findings and decisions

learnings.claim: The cost lever works mechanically: maker fills beat taker in 12/12 matched pairs (mean +$0.14/slot), with near-zero fill loss because the drawdown-buying strategy has price falling into the resting limit.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-17 first net-positive cell entry (reports/exit-grid-drawdown_regime_contrarian_gate-2026-07-17.json)

learnings.claim: The first net-positive configuration (maker·72h·tp8%/sl4% = +$0.031/slot) is statistically zero — far inside noise and the best of 24 cells, so its true expectation is likely negative.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-17 first net-positive cell entry

learnings.claim: The five LLM-surfaced candidates all lost money net of fees, replicating the fee-floor finding: weekend_illiquidity_momentum is gross-positive (Sharpe 1.51) but fee-negative.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-16 gauntlet results (reports/gauntlet-2026-07-16.md)

learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 Retire Bollinger and MA-crossover entry (6-month replay 2026-01-03→2026-07-02)

learnings.claim: The shared position-ceiling architecture works as specified: adding variants moves total P&L only through selection within the cap, not through added exposure.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 front-loaded all 12 variants entry (99.6% rejection, no exposure breach)

learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 outside-eyes institutionalized entry

learnings.claim: Moving the option strike closer (0.5-SD) does not create edge: the 0.5-SD strike clears the flat 20% gate ~10x more often but carries ~31% assignment odds vs ~16% at 1-SD, so 20% is fair at 1-SD but too cheap at 0.5-SD.

learnings.claim: The VRP delta-fair bar was partly self-referential (N(-sd) comes from the same realized-vol Gaussian that places the strike); no profitability is established and the book verdict is PENDING.

learnings.claim: The equity variance-risk-premium may not exist in bonds: TLT was never fairly paid at 1-SD (0%) or 0.5-SD (1.7%), median richness ~3%.

learnings.claim: The realized product of the project was always the instrument + registry + knowledge, not returns; at $200 positions even a real edge is life-irrelevant.
